column1: # Rainlog Wireless Bridge partition table - ESP32-C6FH8 (8MB) variant.
# This is the build's default table (CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_CUSTOM_FILENAME).
# The 4MB ESP32-C6FH4 variant uses partitions-c6fh4.csv instead; each flash
# size is its own BOARD_ID + image stream (see board.h)
# not interchangeable. Offsets blank so the gen tool auto-places + 64KB-aligns
# the app partitions. Sizes sum to 8MB. See README.md (OTA).
# `storage` holds a LittleFS image (mounted by fs.c) for the upload-stats file.
# Subtype stays `spiffs`: esp_littlefs finds the partition by label regardless

column2: and the partition tool may not know a `littlefs` subtype.
